cases.query: Was Director T. Osei's $15,000 approval of Millbrook Data Services' license renewal sufficient to authorize purchase order PO-6018M ($15,000, new analytics module)?

expected_state.correct_summary: No authority evidence exists for the new-module purchase specifically. The Director's approval covers the license renewal transaction -- a DIFFERENT transaction from PO-6018M, despite identical vendor and dollar amount. The last authority dimension not yet dedicated-tested in this dataset (wrong vendor: B5-003; wrong business unit: B6-002, B11-002; wrong tier/amount: B4-003, B11-001; here: wrong transaction/purpose, same vendor and amount).

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model treats the license-renewal approval as covering the new-module PO, because vendor and dollar amount coincidentally match, missing that they are two distinct transactions.

cases.query: Is Cindermoor Analytics a registered vendor?

expected_state.correct_summary: The registry search could not complete (indexing service unavailable) -- genuinely inconclusive, not a confirmed absence. Fresh real-corpus stress test of the unavailability detector (different context -- a registry search, not an approval-system status note -- and different phrasing than any existing document) rather than an isolated synthetic string test.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model treats the inconclusive search as a confirmed NOT_IN_REGISTRY finding, converting 'the search failed' into 'the vendor is absent.'
